id-20261126-news-1.title: World AIDS Day December 1: How to Read HIV Data in Indonesia, Access Testing and ARV Medication, and Fight Stigma

segments.src: Setiap 1 Desember, dunia memperingati Hari AIDS Sedunia.
segments.tr: Every December 1, the world commemorates World AIDS Day.

segments.src: Momen ini sering diisi dengan kampanye dan pemberitaan angka kasus.
segments.tr: This moment is often filled with campaigns and reporting on case numbers.

segments.src: Namun bagi banyak orang, pertanyaan yang paling nyata sebenarnya sederhana: *apakah saya perlu tes, ke mana harus pergi, dan apakah akan ada yang tahu?* Rasa takut akan stigma masih menjadi alasan utama orang menunda pemeriksaan.
segments.tr: However, for many people, the most real question is actually simple: *do I need to get tested, where should I go, and will anyone know?* Fear of stigma remains the main reason people delay testing.

segments.src: Artikel ini membantu Anda memahami data, mengetahui akses layanan, dan mendukung orang di sekitar Anda.
segments.tr: This article helps you understand the data, know how to access services, and support those around you.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan pengganti konsultasi medis. Untuk keputusan tentang pemeriksaan atau pengobatan, bicarakan dengan tenaga kesehatan.
segments.tr: > **Note:** This article is for general information and is not a substitute for medical consultation. For decisions regarding testing or treatment, speak with a healthcare professional.

segments.src: ## 1. Memahami dulu: HIV dan AIDS tidak sama
segments.tr: ## 1. Understanding first: HIV and AIDS are not the same

segments.src: - **HIV** (*Human Immunodeficiency Virus*) adalah virus yang melemahkan sistem kekebalan tubuh.
segments.tr: - **HIV** (*Human Immunodeficiency Virus*) is a virus that weakens the immune system.

segments.src: - **AIDS** adalah kondisi lanjut ketika kekebalan tubuh sudah sangat menurun akibat HIV yang tidak diobati.
segments.tr: - **AIDS** is an advanced condition when the immune system has significantly declined due to untreated HIV.

segments.src: - Dengan pengobatan antiretroviral (ARV) yang teratur, HIV dapat dikendalikan. Banyak orang dengan HIV (ODHIV) menjalani hidup produktif dan panjang.
segments.tr: - With regular antiretroviral (ARV) treatment, HIV can be controlled. Many people living with HIV (PLHIV) lead productive and long lives.

segments.src: HIV **tidak menular** melalui pelukan, berjabat tangan, berbagi alat makan, bekerja satu ruangan, atau gigitan nyamuk.
segments.tr: HIV **is not transmitted** through hugging, shaking hands, sharing eating utensils, working in the same room, or mosquito bites.

segments.src: Penularan terjadi lewat cairan tubuh tertentu, terutama melalui hubungan seksual tanpa pengaman, penggunaan jarum suntik bergantian, transfusi darah yang tidak diskrining, dan dari ibu ke bayi (saat hamil, melahirkan, atau menyusui) bila tidak ada pencegahan.
segments.tr: Transmission occurs through certain bodily fluids, primarily through unprotected sexual intercourse, sharing needles, unscreened blood transfusions, and from mother to baby (during pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding) if there is no prevention.

segments.src: ## 2. Cara membaca data kasus HIV di Indonesia
segments.tr: ## 2. How to read HIV case data in Indonesia

segments.src: Angka kasus HIV sering dikutip tanpa konteks, sehingga mudah disalahpahami.
segments.tr: HIV case numbers are often cited without context, making them easy to misunderstand.

segments.src: Beberapa panduan agar Anda tidak keliru menafsirkannya:
segments.tr: Some guidelines so you do not misinterpret them:

segments.src: Bedakan "perkiraan" dan "yang ditemukan".**
segments.tr: Distinguish between "estimates" and "those found".**

segments.src: Data resmi Kementerian Kesehatan biasanya memuat dua hal: *estimasi* jumlah ODHIV (hasil pemodelan) dan jumlah kasus yang *sudah ditemukan dan dilaporkan*.
segments.tr: Official data from the Ministry of Health usually contains two things: the *estimated* number of PLHIV (modeling results) and the number of cases *already found and reported*.

segments.src: Selisih keduanya menunjukkan orang yang belum mengetahui statusnya.
segments.tr: The difference between the two indicates people who do not yet know their status.

segments.src: Jadi, jumlah kasus yang dilaporkan tidak sama dengan jumlah orang yang terinfeksi sebenarnya.
segments.tr: So, the number of reported cases is not the same as the actual number of infected people.

segments.src: Kenaikan angka tidak selalu berarti penularan melonjak.**
segments.tr: An increase in numbers does not always mean transmission is surging.**

segments.src: Jika tes diperluas, lebih banyak kasus akan ditemukan.
segments.tr: If testing is expanded, more cases will be found.

segments.src: Angka yang naik bisa berarti skrining makin baik, bukan semata-mata penularan makin parah.
segments.tr: Rising numbers could mean better screening, not necessarily that transmission is getting worse.

segments.src: Sebaliknya, angka yang turun bisa mencerminkan berkurangnya pemeriksaan.
segments.tr: Conversely, falling numbers could reflect reduced testing.

segments.src: Perhatikan "cascade" layanan (sering disebut target 95-95-95).**
segments.tr: Pay attention to the service "cascade" (often called the 95-95-95 target).**

segments.src: Target global ini menggambarkan tiga tahap:
segments.tr: This global target describes three stages:

segments.src: 1. Orang dengan HIV mengetahui statusnya.
segments.tr: 1. People with HIV know their status.

segments.src: 2. Yang sudah tahu status menjalani pengobatan ARV.
segments.tr: 2. Those who know their status are undergoing ARV treatment.

segments.src: 3. Yang berobat mencapai kondisi virus tertekan (*viral load* tidak terdeteksi atau sangat rendah).
segments.tr: 3. Those on treatment reach a suppressed viral condition (*viral load* is undetectable or very low).

segments.src: Dari sini terlihat di tahap mana masih ada kesenjangan, misalnya banyak yang belum tes, atau sudah tes tetapi belum memulai atau tidak melanjutkan pengobatan.
segments.tr: From this, it can be seen at which stage there is still a gap, for example, many have not been tested, or have been tested but have not started or are not continuing treatment.

segments.src: Lihat sebaran dan kelompok, bukan hanya angka nasional.**
segments.tr: Look at the distribution and groups, not just national numbers.**

segments.src: Beban kasus berbeda antardaerah dan antarkelompok usia.
segments.tr: The burden of cases differs between regions and age groups.

segments.src: Data juga mencakup kasus pada ibu rumah tangga dan anak, sehingga HIV bukan isu satu kelompok saja.
segments.tr: Data also includes cases among housewives and children, so HIV is not an issue for just one group.

segments.src: Hindari menarik kesimpulan yang menyudutkan kelompok tertentu.
segments.tr: Avoid drawing conclusions that stigmatize certain groups.

segments.src: Periksa sumber dan tahun data.**
segments.tr: Check the source and year of the data.**

segments.src: Gunakan sumber resmi seperti Kementerian Kesehatan, Dinas Kesehatan setempat, atau UNAIDS.
segments.tr: Use official sources such as the Ministry of Health, local Health Offices, or UNAIDS.

segments.src: Perhatikan tahun pelaporan, karena angka lama sering beredar kembali di media sosial seolah-olah baru.
segments.tr: Pay attention to the reporting year, because old numbers often circulate again on social media as if they were new.

segments.src: ## 3. Tes HIV: apa, di mana, dan bagaimana
segments.tr: ## 3. HIV testing: what, where, and how

segments.src: ### Mengapa perlu tes?
segments.tr: ### Why get tested?

segments.src: Tes adalah satu-satunya cara mengetahui status HIV.
segments.tr: Testing is the only way to know your HIV status.

segments.src: Banyak orang dengan HIV tidak merasakan gejala selama bertahun-tahun.
segments.tr: Many people with HIV do not experience symptoms for years.

segments.src: Semakin dini diketahui, semakin baik hasil pengobatan dan semakin kecil risiko menularkan.
segments.tr: The earlier it is known, the better the treatment outcome and the smaller the risk of transmission.

segments.src: ### Siapa yang disarankan tes?
segments.tr: ### Who is advised to get tested?

segments.src: - Orang yang pernah berisiko, misalnya berhubungan seksual tanpa pengaman atau berbagi jarum suntik.
segments.tr: - People who have been at risk, for example, having unprotected sexual intercourse or sharing needles.

segments.src: - Ibu hamil (tes HIV termasuk dalam pemeriksaan antenatal rutin).
segments.tr: - Pregnant women (HIV testing is included in routine antenatal care).

segments.src: - Pasangan dari orang yang terdiagnosis HIV.
segments.tr: - Partners of people diagnosed with HIV.

segments.src: - Orang dengan tuberkulosis (TBC) atau infeksi menular seksual.
segments.tr: - People with tuberculosis (TB) or sexually transmitted infections.

segments.src: - Siapa pun yang ingin memastikan statusnya.
segments.tr: - Anyone who wants to confirm their status.

segments.src: ### Di mana tes bisa dilakukan?
segments.tr: ### Where can testing be done?

segments.src: - **Puskesmas** dan rumah sakit pemerintah maupun swasta.
segments.tr: - **Community Health Centers (Puskesmas)** and government or private hospitals.

segments.src: - **Klinik** yang menyediakan layanan konseling dan tes sukarela (VCT/KTS).
segments.tr: - **Clinics** that provide voluntary counseling and testing (VCT) services.

segments.src: - **Organisasi masyarakat sipil** dan komunitas yang bekerja sama dengan fasilitas kesehatan.
segments.tr: - **Civil society organizations** and communities working with health facilities.

segments.src: - Sebagian daerah menyediakan layanan tes bergerak (mobile VCT) dalam acara tertentu.
segments.tr: - Some regions provide mobile testing services (mobile VCT) at certain events.

segments.src: Tarif dapat berbeda antarfasilitas.
segments.tr: Rates may differ between facilities.

segments.src: Banyak layanan pemerintah menyediakan tes tanpa biaya atau dengan biaya terjangkau.
segments.tr: Many government services provide testing at no cost or at an affordable cost.

segments.src: Tanyakan lebih dahulu kepada fasilitas yang Anda tuju.
segments.tr: Ask the facility you are heading to beforehand.

segments.src: ### Hal penting seputar tes
segments.tr: ### Important things about testing

segments.src: - **Konseling** diberikan sebelum dan sesudah tes. Anda berhak bertanya dan memutuskan dengan sadar.
segments.tr: - **Counseling** is provided before and after the test. You have the right to ask questions and decide consciously.

segments.src: - **Kerahasiaan** hasil tes adalah hak Anda. Tenaga kesehatan wajib menjaganya.
segments.tr: - **Confidentiality** of test results is your right. Health workers are obligated to maintain it.

segments.src: - **Masa jendela (*window period*):** infeksi yang sangat baru bisa belum terdeteksi. Jika ada risiko baru-baru ini, tenaga kesehatan mungkin menyarankan tes ulang.
segments.tr: - **Window period:** a very recent infection may not be detected yet. If there has been a recent risk, health workers may suggest re-testing.

segments.src: - Hasil reaktif pada tes awal perlu **dikonfirmasi** dengan tes lanjutan sebelum diagnosis ditegakkan.
segments.tr: - A reactive result on an initial test needs to be **confirmed** with a follow-up test before a diagnosis is established.

segments.src: ## 4. Pengobatan ARV: akses dan dukungan BPJS
segments.tr: ## 4. ARV treatment: access and BPJS support

segments.src: ARV (antiretroviral) tidak menyembuhkan HIV, tetapi menekan jumlah virus sehingga kekebalan tubuh terjaga dan risiko penularan turun drastis.
segments.tr: ARV (antiretroviral) does not cure HIV, but it suppresses the amount of virus so that the immune system is maintained and the risk of transmission drops drastically.

segments.src: Orang yang rutin minum ARV hingga virusnya tidak terdeteksi tidak menularkan HIV melalui hubungan seksual (prinsip **U=U**, *Undetectable = Untransmittable*).
segments.tr: People who take ARVs regularly until the virus is undetectable do not transmit HIV through sexual intercourse (the **U=U** principle, *Undetectable = Untransmittable*).

segments.src: ### Cara memulai
segments.tr: ### How to start

segments.src: 1. Datang ke fasilitas yang menyediakan layanan perawatan, dukungan, dan pengobatan (PDP/PDP HIV), umumnya rumah sakit rujukan atau puskesmas tertentu.
segments.tr: 1. Come to a facility that provides care, support, and treatment services (PDP/HIV PDP), generally referral hospitals or certain community health centers (Puskesmas).

segments.src: 2. Dokter akan melakukan pemeriksaan awal, termasuk kondisi kesehatan secara umum dan penyakit penyerta seperti TBC.
segments.tr: 2. The doctor will perform an initial examination, including general health conditions and comorbidities such as TB.

segments.src: 3. Pengobatan dimulai sesegera mungkin sesuai penilaian dokter, lalu dipantau secara berkala, termasuk pemeriksaan *viral load*.
segments.tr: 3. Treatment starts as soon as possible according to the doctor's assessment, then monitored periodically, including *viral load* testing.

segments.src: ### Peran BPJS Kesehatan
segments.tr: ### The role of BPJS Kesehatan

segments.src: - Peserta JKN-BPJS Kesehatan dapat mengakses layanan pengobatan HIV sesuai ketentuan fasilitas kesehatan yang bekerja sama.
segments.tr: - JKN-BPJS Kesehatan participants can access HIV treatment services according to the provisions of collaborating health facilities.

segments.src: - Pada umumnya, obat ARV di Indonesia disediakan pemerintah melalui program nasional, sehingga pasien tidak dibebani biaya obat.
segments.tr: - In general, ARV drugs in Indonesia are provided by the government through a national program, so patients are not charged for the medication.

segments.src: - Mulailah dari fasilitas kesehatan tingkat pertama (FKTP) tempat Anda terdaftar bila diperlukan rujukan, kecuali dalam kondisi gawat darurat.
segments.tr: - Start at the primary health facility (FKTP) where you are registered if a referral is needed, except in emergency conditions.

segments.src: - Bagi yang belum memiliki BPJS, tanyakan kepada fasilitas kesehatan atau Dinas Kesehatan tentang cara pendaftaran atau skema pembiayaan lain yang tersedia.
segments.tr: - For those who do not yet have BPJS, ask the health facility or the Health Office about registration methods or other available financing schemes.

segments.src: Ketentuan teknis dapat berubah dan berbeda antardaerah.
segments.tr: Technical provisions may change and differ between regions.

segments.src: Konfirmasikan ke BPJS Kesehatan (Care Center 165) atau fasilitas kesehatan terdekat.
segments.tr: Confirm with BPJS Kesehatan (Care Center 165) or the nearest health facility.

segments.src: ### Kunci keberhasilan: disiplin dan berkelanjutan
segments.tr: ### Key to success: discipline and sustainability

segments.src: - Minum obat **setiap hari pada waktu yang sama**.
segments.tr: - Take medication **every day at the same time**.

segments.src: - Jangan menghentikan atau mengganti obat tanpa arahan dokter.
segments.tr: - Do not stop or change medication without a doctor's direction.

segments.src: - Datang kontrol sesuai jadwal.
segments.tr: - Come for check-ups according to the schedule.

segments.src: - Libatkan kelompok dukungan sebaya bila perlu. Dukungan sesama ODHIV terbukti membantu kepatuhan berobat.
segments.tr: - Involve peer support groups if necessary. Support from fellow PLHIV is proven to help treatment adherence.

segments.src: ## 5. Mengapa stigma berbahaya, dan bagaimana melawannya
segments.tr: ## 5. Why stigma is dangerous, and how to fight it

segments.src: Stigma membuat orang menunda tes, menyembunyikan status, dan putus berobat.
segments.tr: Stigma makes people delay testing, hide their status, and stop treatment.

segments.src: Akibatnya, kondisi kesehatan memburuk dan peluang pencegahan hilang.
segments.tr: As a result, health conditions worsen and prevention opportunities are lost.

segments.src: Melawan stigma bukan sekadar soal empati, tetapi bagian dari upaya kesehatan masyarakat.
segments.tr: Fighting stigma is not just about empathy, but part of public health efforts.

segments.src: ### Peran keluarga
segments.tr: ### The role of family

segments.src: - **Dengarkan tanpa menghakimi.** Tanyakan apa yang dibutuhkan, bukan bagaimana awalnya bisa terjadi.
segments.tr: - **Listen without judging.** Ask what is needed, not how it happened in the first place.

segments.src: - **Jaga kerahasiaan.** Status HIV seseorang adalah haknya untuk diceritakan atau tidak.
segments.tr: - **Maintain confidentiality.** A person's HIV status is their right to tell or not.

segments.src: - **Bantu kepatuhan berobat**, misalnya mengingatkan jadwal minum obat atau menemani kontrol bila diminta.
segments.tr: - **Help with treatment adherence**, for example, reminding them of the medication schedule or accompanying them to check-ups if requested.

segments.src: - **Tetap berinteraksi seperti biasa.** Makan bersama, berbagi ruangan, dan berpelukan aman.
segments.tr: - **Continue interacting as usual.** Eating together, sharing a room, and hugging are safe.

segments.src: - Pastikan anggota keluarga mendapat informasi yang benar agar tidak termakan mitos.
segments.tr: - Ensure family members get correct information so they are not swayed by myths.

segments.src: ### Peran lingkungan kerja
segments.tr: ### The role of the work environment

segments.src: - Tidak ada dasar medis untuk melarang orang dengan HIV bekerja. Prinsip nondiskriminasi sejalan dengan pedoman ketenagakerjaan, termasuk pedoman Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan dan ILO terkait HIV di tempat kerja.
segments.tr: - There is no medical basis for prohibiting people with HIV from working. The principle of non-discrimination is in line with employment guidelines, including the Ministry of Manpower and ILO guidelines regarding HIV in the workplace.

segments.src: - **Jangan mewajibkan tes HIV** sebagai syarat rekrutmen atau mempertahankan pekerjaan, dan jangan membuka status karyawan kepada pihak lain.
segments.tr: - **Do not require HIV testing** as a condition for recruitment or retaining employment, and do not disclose an employee's status to other parties.

segments.src: - Sediakan **informasi dan edukasi** bagi seluruh karyawan, termasuk kebijakan tertulis tentang kerahasiaan dan antidiskriminasi.
segments.tr: - Provide **information and education** for all employees, including written policies on confidentiality and anti-discrimination.

segments.src: - Berikan fleksibilitas yang wajar untuk kontrol rutin ke fasilitas kesehatan, sebagaimana penyakit kronis lainnya.
segments.tr: - Provide reasonable flexibility for routine check-ups at health facilities, just like other chronic diseases.

segments.src: - Tangani dengan tegas candaan, gosip, atau perundungan terkait status kesehatan.
segments.tr: - Handle jokes, gossip, or bullying related to health status firmly.

segments.src: ### Peran kita sebagai individu dan pengguna media sosial
segments.tr: ### Our role as individuals and social media users

segments.src: - Gunakan bahasa yang menghormati. Gunakan istilah "orang dengan HIV (ODHIV)", bukan sebutan yang merendahkan.
segments.tr: - Use respectful language. Use the term "people living with HIV (PLHIV)", not derogatory terms.

segments.src: - Periksa informasi sebelum membagikannya. Jangan menyebarkan dugaan tentang status kesehatan seseorang.
segments.tr: - Check information before sharing it. Do not spread speculation about someone's health status.

segments.src: - Jangan membagikan data pribadi pasien atau tangkapan layar hasil tes.
segments.tr: - Do not share patient personal data or screenshots of test results.

segments.src: ## 6. Langkah praktis menjelang 1 Desember
segments.tr: ## 6. Practical steps leading up to December 1

segments.src: 1. **Cari informasi layanan terdekat.** Tanyakan ke puskesmas atau Dinas Kesehatan setempat tentang jadwal dan lokasi tes.
segments.tr: 1. **Find information on the nearest service.** Ask the local community health center (Puskesmas) or Health Office about the schedule and location for testing.

segments.src: 2. **Ajak orang terdekat berdiskusi** secara terbuka dan tanpa menyalahkan.
segments.tr: 2. **Invite loved ones to discuss** openly and without blaming.

segments.src: 3. **Bila ragu, mulai dari konseling.** Anda tidak harus langsung tes pada kunjungan pertama.
segments.tr: 3. **If in doubt, start with counseling.** You do not have to get tested immediately on the first visit.

segments.src: 4. **Simpan sumber resmi**, misalnya layanan informasi Kementerian Kesehatan (Halo Kemenkes 1500-567) dan situs resmi pemerintah.
segments.tr: 4. **Save official sources**, for example, the Ministry of Health information service (Halo Kemenkes 1500-567) and official government websites.

segments.src: 5. **Bagikan informasi yang benar** kepada keluarga, rekan kerja, dan komunitas Anda.
segments.tr: 5. **Share correct information** with your family, colleagues, and community.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: HIV adalah kondisi kesehatan yang kini dapat dikendalikan dengan tes dini dan pengobatan teratur.
segments.tr: HIV is a health condition that can now be controlled with early testing and regular treatment.

segments.src: Hambatan terbesar sering kali bukan ketersediaan obat, melainkan rasa takut dihakimi.
segments.tr: The biggest obstacle is often not the availability of medication, but the fear of being judged.

segments.src: Dengan membaca data secara kritis, mengetahui jalur layanan, dan membangun lingkungan yang suportif, kita membantu lebih banyak orang berani memeriksakan diri dan menjalani pengobatan.
segments.tr: By reading data critically, knowing service pathways, and building a supportive environment, we help more people have the courage to get tested and undergo treatment.

segments.src: Peringatan Hari AIDS Sedunia tahun ini bisa menjadi pengingat bahwa langkah kecil, seperti bertanya, mendengarkan, atau mengantar seseorang tes, berdampak besar.
segments.tr: This year's World AIDS Day commemoration can be a reminder that small steps, such as asking, listening, or accompanying someone to get tested, have a big impact.

segments.src: *Informasi dalam artikel ini bersifat edukatif.
segments.tr: *The information in this article is educational.

segments.src: Untuk kondisi pribadi, konsultasikan dengan dokter atau tenaga kesehatan terpercaya.*
segments.tr: For personal conditions, consult a doctor or trusted healthcare professional.*

id-20261126-news-2.title: Fuel Prices on 1 December: How to Read Monthly Adjustments, Subsidized vs Non-subsidized Fuel, and Their Impact on Daily Costs

segments.src: Setiap awal bulan, pengguna kendaraan biasanya mengecek aplikasi atau papan harga di SPBU untuk melihat apakah harga bahan bakar minyak (BBM) berubah.
segments.tr: At the start of every month, vehicle users usually check the app or the price board at the gas station to see whether fuel (BBM) prices have changed.

segments.src: Menjelang 1 Desember, rasa penasaran itu muncul lagi.
segments.tr: As 1 December approaches, that curiosity comes up again.

segments.src: Artikel ini tidak memuat angka harga terbaru karena angka resmi bisa berbeda antar wilayah dan antar operator.
segments.tr: This article does not include the latest price figures, because official numbers can differ between regions and between operators.

segments.src: Fokusnya adalah cara membaca penyesuaian harga, supaya Anda paham mengapa harga naik, turun, atau tetap, dan apa dampaknya bagi pengeluaran sehari-hari.
segments.tr: The focus is on how to read price adjustments, so you understand why prices rise, fall, or stay the same, and what that means for your everyday spending.

segments.src: > **Catatan:** Untuk harga yang berlaku, selalu rujuk pengumuman resmi dari operator SPBU, seperti Pertamina, atau aplikasi resminya. Harga dapat berbeda menurut provinsi karena perbedaan pajak daerah dan biaya distribusi.
segments.tr: > **Note:** For the price that applies, always refer to the official announcement from the fuel operator, such as Pertamina, or its official app. Prices can differ by province because of differences in regional taxes and distribution costs.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Harga BBM Nonsubsidi Berubah Tiap Bulan?
segments.tr: ## Why Do Non-subsidized Fuel Prices Change Every Month?

segments.src: BBM nonsubsidi mengikuti mekanisme pasar.
segments.tr: Non-subsidized fuel follows market mechanisms.

segments.src: Operator SPBU meninjau harganya secara berkala, umumnya sebulan sekali.
segments.tr: Fuel operators review their prices periodically, generally once a month.

segments.src: Ada beberapa faktor utama yang memengaruhinya.
segments.tr: Several main factors affect those prices.

segments.src: 1. **Harga minyak dunia dan harga produk olahan.** Acuan yang sering dipakai adalah harga rata-rata produk BBM di kawasan Asia Tenggara, seperti MOPS (Mean of Platts Singapore), bukan hanya harga minyak mentah. Harga minyak mentah dan harga bensin atau solar olahan bisa bergerak tidak sama.
segments.tr: 1. **World oil prices and refined product prices.** A commonly used benchmark is the average price of fuel products in the Southeast Asia region, such as MOPS (Mean of Platts Singapore), not just the crude oil price. Crude oil prices and refined petrol or diesel prices do not always move in the same direction.

segments.src: 2. **Kurs rupiah terhadap dolar AS.** Minyak diperdagangkan dalam dolar AS. Saat rupiah melemah, biaya impor dalam rupiah naik, sehingga harga eceran ikut tertekan naik walau harga minyak dunia stabil.
segments.tr: 2. **The rupiah's exchange rate against the US dollar.** Oil is traded in US dollars. When the rupiah weakens, the cost of imports in rupiah rises, so the retail price is pushed up even when world oil prices are stable.

segments.src: 3. **Biaya logistik dan distribusi.** Biaya pengangkutan, penyimpanan, dan penyaluran ke SPBU memengaruhi harga akhir. Ini salah satu alasan harga di daerah terpencil sering berbeda.
segments.tr: 3. **Logistics and distribution costs.** The costs of transport, storage, and delivery to gas stations affect the final price. This is one reason prices in remote areas often differ.

segments.src: 4. **Pajak dan pungutan.** Pajak pertambahan nilai (PPN) dan pajak bahan bakar kendaraan bermotor (PBBKB) menjadi bagian dari harga. Tarif PBBKB ditetapkan daerah, jadi harga bisa berbeda antar provinsi.
segments.tr: 4. **Taxes and levies.** Value-added tax (PPN) and the motor vehicle fuel tax (PBBKB) are part of the price. PBBKB rates are set by each region, so prices can differ between provinces.

segments.src: 5. **Margin operator.** Setiap badan usaha menambahkan margin untuk menutup biaya operasional dan investasi.
segments.tr: 5. **Operator margin.** Each business entity adds a margin to cover its operating and investment costs.

segments.src: Karena periode acuan umumnya berupa rata-rata beberapa pekan sebelumnya, perubahan harga di SPBU sering terlihat terlambat dibanding berita harga minyak harian.
segments.tr: Because the reference period is generally an average of several preceding weeks, changes at the pump often appear later than daily news about oil prices.

segments.src: Jadi, lonjakan harga minyak pekan ini belum tentu langsung tercermin pada harga 1 Desember.
segments.tr: So a jump in oil prices this week is not necessarily reflected in the 1 December price.

segments.src: ## Subsidi dan Nonsubsidi: Apa Bedanya?
segments.tr: ## Subsidized and Non-subsidized: What's the Difference?

segments.src: Di Indonesia, jenis BBM dikelompokkan menurut cara penetapan harganya.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, fuel types are grouped by how their prices are set.

segments.src: | Kelompok | Contoh | Penetapan harga |
segments.tr: | Group | Examples | Price setting |

segments.src: | BBM bersubsidi atau penugasan | Solar bersubsidi (Biosolar), Pertalite | Ditetapkan pemerintah, tidak mengikuti perubahan bulanan |
segments.tr: | Subsidized or mandated fuel | Subsidized diesel (Biosolar), Pertalite | Set by the government, does not follow monthly changes |

segments.src: | BBM nonsubsidi | Pertamax, Pertamax Turbo, Dexlite, Pertamina Dex | Mengikuti mekanisme pasar, disesuaikan berkala |
segments.tr: | Non-subsidized fuel | Pertamax, Pertamax Turbo, Dexlite, Pertamina Dex | Follows market mechanisms, adjusted periodically |

segments.src: **Pertalite** (RON 90) termasuk jenis BBM khusus penugasan.
segments.tr: **Pertalite** (RON 90) is a mandated fuel type.

segments.src: Harga jualnya dijaga pemerintah, dan selisih terhadap harga keekonomian ditanggung lewat skema kompensasi.
segments.tr: Its selling price is held by the government, and the gap relative to the economic price is covered through a compensation scheme.

segments.src: **Solar bersubsidi** mendapat subsidi tetap per liter dan dijaga harganya, terutama untuk angkutan barang, angkutan umum, dan sektor tertentu.
segments.tr: **Subsidized diesel** receives a fixed subsidy per liter and its price is maintained, mainly for freight transport, public transport, and certain sectors.

segments.src: **Pertamax** (RON 92) dan **Pertamax Turbo** (RON 98) adalah BBM nonsubsidi.
segments.tr: **Pertamax** (RON 92) and **Pertamax Turbo** (RON 98) are non-subsidized fuels.

segments.src: Harganya bergerak mengikuti faktor pasar di atas.
segments.tr: Their prices move with the market factors described above.

segments.src: **Dexlite** dan **Pertamina Dex** adalah solar nonsubsidi dengan kualitas dan angka cetana lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: **Dexlite** and **Pertamina Dex** are non-subsidized diesel fuels with higher quality and higher cetane numbers.

segments.src: Badan usaha lain, seperti Shell, BP-AKR, dan Vivo, juga menjual BBM nonsubsidi dengan harga masing-masing.
segments.tr: Other business entities, such as Shell, BP-AKR, and Vivo, also sell non-subsidized fuel at their own prices.

segments.src: Perbandingan harga antar operator layak dilakukan, tetapi bandingkan juga spesifikasi (angka oktan) dan ketersediaan di dekat rute Anda.
segments.tr: Comparing prices between operators is worthwhile, but also compare specifications (octane rating) and availability along your route.

segments.src: ## Cara Membaca Pengumuman Harga
segments.tr: ## How to Read a Price Announcement

segments.src: - **Cek jenis BBM yang Anda pakai.** Perubahan harga Pertamax tidak otomatis berlaku untuk Pertalite atau Biosolar.
segments.tr: - **Check which fuel you use.** A change in Pertamax prices does not automatically apply to Pertalite or Biosolar.

segments.src: - **Lihat wilayah.** Harga dipublikasikan per wilayah. Gunakan daftar harga untuk provinsi Anda.
segments.tr: - **Look at your region.** Prices are published by region. Use the price list for your province.

segments.src: - **Bandingkan dengan bulan lalu dalam persentase.** Selisih beberapa ratus rupiah per liter terlihat kecil, tetapi bagi pengemudi harian dampaknya terakumulasi sebulan penuh.
segments.tr: - **Compare with last month as a percentage.** A difference of a few hundred rupiah per liter looks small, but for daily drivers the impact adds up over a full month.

segments.src: - **Pahami arah, bukan hanya angka.** Jika harga minyak dunia turun tetapi rupiah melemah, efeknya bisa saling meniadakan.
segments.tr: - **Understand the direction, not just the number.** If world oil prices fall but the rupiah weakens, the effects may cancel each other out.

segments.src: ## Dampaknya bagi Ongkos Harian
segments.tr: ## Impact on Daily Costs

segments.src: ### Pengendara pribadi
segments.tr: ### Private drivers

segments.src: Pemilik kendaraan yang memakai BBM nonsubsidi paling langsung merasakan perubahan.
segments.tr: Vehicle owners who use non-subsidized fuel feel the changes most directly.

segments.src: Sebagai gambaran sederhana, kendaraan yang mengisi 10 liter per minggu akan mengisi sekitar 40 liter per bulan.
segments.tr: As a simple illustration, a vehicle that uses 10 liters per week needs about 40 liters per month.

segments.src: Jika harga bergeser Rp500 per liter, selisih pengeluaran bulanannya sekitar Rp20.000.
segments.tr: If the price shifts by Rp500 per liter, the monthly difference in spending is about Rp20,000.

segments.src: Angka ini hanya contoh hitungan, bukan harga resmi.
segments.tr: This figure is only an example calculation, not an official price.

segments.src: Anda bisa menyesuaikannya dengan konsumsi sendiri.
segments.tr: You can adjust it to your own consumption.

segments.src: ### Transportasi umum dan ojek
segments.tr: ### Public transport and ride-hailing motorcycles

segments.src: Tarif angkutan umum dan ojek daring dipengaruhi biaya bahan bakar, tetapi tarif resminya tidak berubah tiap bulan.
segments.tr: Public transport and online motorcycle taxi fares are affected by fuel costs, but official fares do not change every month.

segments.src: Perubahan tarif biasanya lewat keputusan pemerintah atau penyesuaian operator, dan terjadi bila perubahan biaya bersifat cukup besar dan bertahan.
segments.tr: Fare changes usually come through government decisions or operator adjustments, and happen when the cost change is large and sustained.

segments.src: ### Harga barang dan makanan
segments.tr: ### Prices of goods and food

segments.src: BBM, terutama solar, memengaruhi biaya angkut barang.
segments.tr: Fuel, especially diesel, affects the cost of transporting goods.

segments.src: Jika harga solar yang dijaga pemerintah stabil, tekanan ke harga pangan lewat jalur ini cenderung terbatas.
segments.tr: If the government-maintained diesel price stays stable, pressure on food prices through this channel tends to be limited.

segments.src: Perubahan harga BBM nonsubsidi lebih berpengaruh pada pelaku usaha yang memakai BBM nonsubsidi untuk armada atau mesin.
segments.tr: Changes in non-subsidized fuel prices have a bigger impact on businesses that use non-subsidized fuel for their fleets or machinery.

segments.src: Harga pangan sendiri juga dipengaruhi cuaca, panen, dan permintaan musiman, sehingga kenaikan harga makanan tidak selalu berasal dari BBM.
segments.tr: Food prices are also influenced by weather, harvests, and seasonal demand, so rising food prices do not always come from fuel.

segments.src: ### Menjelang akhir tahun
segments.tr: ### Toward year-end

segments.src: Desember biasanya diwarnai libur panjang dan mobilitas tinggi.
segments.tr: December is usually marked by long holidays and high mobility.

segments.src: Permintaan BBM dan tarif transportasi sering naik karena faktor musiman, terlepas dari perubahan harga resmi BBM.
segments.tr: Fuel demand and transport fares often rise for seasonal reasons, regardless of official fuel price changes.

segments.src: ## Tips Mengelola Pengeluaran BBM
segments.tr: ## Tips for Managing Fuel Spending

segments.src: 1. **Catat konsumsi.** Hitung berapa liter dan berapa rupiah yang keluar per bulan agar perubahan harga mudah dinilai.
segments.tr: 1. **Keep a record of your consumption.** Calculate how many liters and how many rupiah you spend each month so that price changes are easy to assess.

segments.src: 2. **Pakai BBM sesuai spesifikasi kendaraan.** Lihat buku manual atau tutup tangki. Memakai oktan lebih rendah dari anjuran pabrikan dapat merugikan mesin dalam jangka panjang, dan memakai oktan lebih tinggi dari kebutuhan belum tentu memberi manfaat.
segments.tr: 2. **Use fuel that matches your vehicle's specifications.** Check the owner's manual or the inside of the fuel tank cap. Using a lower octane than the manufacturer recommends can harm the engine over the long term, and using a higher octane than needed does not necessarily bring any benefit.

segments.src: 3. **Rawat kendaraan.** Tekanan ban yang tepat, filter bersih, dan servis berkala membantu efisiensi bahan bakar.
segments.tr: 3. **Maintain your vehicle.** Correct tire pressure, clean filters, and regular servicing help fuel efficiency.

segments.src: 4. **Atur rute dan waktu.** Menghindari jam macet mengurangi konsumsi.
segments.tr: 4. **Plan your route and timing.** Avoiding rush-hour traffic reduces consumption.

segments.src: 5. **Gabungkan perjalanan.** Satu perjalanan untuk beberapa urusan lebih hemat daripada beberapa perjalanan terpisah.
segments.tr: 5. **Combine trips.** One trip for several errands is more economical than several separate trips.

segments.src: 6. **Pertimbangkan alternatif.** Untuk rute rutin, angkutan umum, kendaraan bersama, atau kerja jarak jauh sebagian hari bisa menekan biaya.
segments.tr: 6. **Consider alternatives.** For regular routes, public transport, shared vehicles, or working remotely for part of the week can cut costs.

segments.src: 7. **Gunakan sumber resmi.** Hindari kabar harga dari pesan berantai atau akun tidak jelas. Verifikasi di situs atau aplikasi operator.
segments.tr: 7. **Use official sources.** Avoid price news from chain messages or unclear accounts. Verify on the operator's website or app.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Harga BBM nonsubsidi pada 1 Desember akan mencerminkan gabungan harga produk minyak, kurs rupiah, biaya distribusi, dan pajak dalam periode acuan tertentu.
segments.tr: The non-subsidized fuel price on 1 December will reflect the combined effect of oil product prices, the rupiah exchange rate, distribution costs, and taxes within a given reference period.

segments.src: Pertalite dan Biosolar mengikuti kebijakan pemerintah, sedangkan Pertamax dan sejenisnya mengikuti pasar.
segments.tr: Pertalite and Biosolar follow government policy, while Pertamax and similar fuels follow the market.

segments.src: Dengan memahami perbedaan ini dan mencatat konsumsi sendiri, Anda bisa menilai dampak perubahan harga terhadap anggaran tanpa terbawa kabar yang belum jelas.
segments.tr: By understanding these differences and keeping a record of your own consumption, you can judge how price changes affect your budget without being swayed by unclear news.

segments.src: Periksa selalu harga resmi di wilayah Anda sebelum mengambil keputusan.
segments.tr: Always check the official price in your region before making a decision.

segments.tr: The figures in the examples are illustrations only.*

id-20261126-news-3.title: International Human Rights Day, 10 December: Limits of Freedom of Expression, the ITE Law, and Complaint Channels to Komnas HAM and LPSK

segments.src: Setiap 10 Desember, dunia memperingati Hari Hak Asasi Manusia (HAM) Internasional.
segments.tr: Every 10 December, the world commemorates International Human Rights Day.

segments.src: Tanggal itu merujuk pada pengesahan Deklarasi Universal Hak Asasi Manusia (DUHAM) oleh Majelis Umum Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa pada 1948.
segments.tr: That date marks the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) by the United Nations General Assembly in 1948.

segments.src: Di Indonesia, peringatan ini sering menjadi momen untuk menilai seberapa luas ruang warga dalam menyampaikan pendapat, terutama di media sosial yang kini menjadi ruang publik utama.
segments.tr: In Indonesia, this commemoration often serves as a moment to assess how much room citizens have to express their views, especially on social media, which has become the main public space.

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum dasar hukum kebebasan berekspresi, batas yang diatur undang-undang, pasal-pasal Undang-Undang Informasi dan Transaksi Elektronik (UU ITE) yang kerap dipersoalkan, serta langkah praktis jika warga ingin melapor atau meminta perlindungan.
segments.tr: This article summarizes the legal basis for freedom of expression, the limits set by law, the articles of the Electronic Information and Transactions Law (UU ITE) that are often disputed, and practical steps citizens can take if they want to report or seek protection.

segments.src: Isinya bersifat informasi umum, bukan nasihat hukum untuk kasus tertentu.
segments.tr: This content is general information, not legal advice for specific cases.

segments.src: ## Dasar hukum kebebasan berekspresi
segments.tr: ## Legal basis for freedom of expression

segments.src: Kebebasan berpendapat dijamin di beberapa tingkat aturan:
segments.tr: Freedom of opinion is guaranteed at several levels of regulation:

segments.src: - **UUD 1945 Pasal 28E ayat (3)**: setiap orang berhak atas kebebasan berserikat, berkumpul, dan mengeluarkan pendapat.
segments.tr: - **1945 Constitution Article 28E paragraph (3)**: everyone has the right to freedom of association, assembly, and expression of opinion.

segments.src: - **UUD 1945 Pasal 28F**: setiap orang berhak berkomunikasi dan memperoleh informasi, serta mencari, memiliki, menyimpan, mengolah, dan menyampaikan informasi.
segments.tr: - **1945 Constitution Article 28F**: everyone has the right to communicate and obtain information, and to seek, possess, store, process, and convey information.

segments.src: - **UU No. 39 Tahun 1999 tentang Hak Asasi Manusia**, yang mengatur hak menyampaikan pendapat dan hak atas informasi.
segments.tr: - **Law No. 39 of 1999 on Human Rights**, which regulates the right to express opinions and the right to information.

segments.src: - **UU No. 12 Tahun 2005**, yang mengesahkan Kovenan Internasional tentang Hak Sipil dan Politik (ICCPR). Pasal 19 kovenan ini menjamin kebebasan berekspresi.
segments.tr: - **Law No. 12 of 2005**, which ratifies the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR). Article 19 of this covenant guarantees freedom of expression.

segments.src: ## Kebebasan itu tidak mutlak
segments.tr: ## Freedom is not absolute

segments.src: Jaminan tersebut punya batas.
segments.tr: These guarantees have limits.

segments.src: Pasal 28J ayat (2) UUD 1945 menyatakan bahwa pembatasan hak boleh dilakukan melalui undang-undang, dengan tujuan menjamin pengakuan dan penghormatan atas hak orang lain serta memenuhi tuntutan keadilan sesuai pertimbangan moral, nilai agama, keamanan, dan ketertiban umum dalam masyarakat demokratis.
segments.tr: Article 28J paragraph (2) of the 1945 Constitution states that restrictions on rights may be imposed by law, with the aim of securing recognition and respect for the rights of others and meeting the demands of justice in line with moral considerations, religious values, security, and public order in a democratic society.

segments.src: Standar internasional juga menekankan bahwa pembatasan harus memenuhi tiga syarat: diatur jelas dalam hukum, memiliki tujuan yang sah, dan benar-benar diperlukan serta proporsional.
segments.tr: International standards also emphasize that restrictions must meet three requirements: they must be clearly set out in law, pursue a legitimate aim, and be truly necessary and proportionate.

segments.src: Karena itu, kritik terhadap kebijakan atau pejabat publik pada dasarnya berbeda dari penyebaran informasi bohong, ujaran kebencian, atau tuduhan pribadi tanpa dasar.
segments.tr: Therefore, criticism of policies or public officials is fundamentally different from spreading false information, hate speech, or baseless personal accusations.

segments.src: ## Pasal UU ITE yang sering dipersoalkan
segments.tr: ## ITE Law articles often challenged

segments.src: UU ITE (UU No.
segments.tr: The ITE Law (Law No.

segments.src: 19 Tahun 2016 dan perubahan kedua melalui UU No.
segments.tr: 19 of 2016, and then a second amendment through Law No.

segments.src: 1 Tahun 2024.
Sejumlah ketentuan sering menjadi bahan perdebatan karena rumusannya dinilai dapat ditafsirkan luas:
segments.tr: Several provisions are frequently debated because their wording is considered open to broad interpretation:

segments.src: 1. **Pasal 27 ayat (3) tentang pencemaran nama baik.** Pasal ini kerap dipakai dalam sengketa pendapat. Setelah perubahan, rumusannya dikaitkan dengan ketentuan KUHP dan dipertegas bahwa perbuatan itu berupa tuduhan atas suatu hal yang dimaksudkan agar diketahui umum.
segments.tr: 1. **Article 27 paragraph (3) on defamation.** This article is often used in disputes over opinions. After the amendment, its wording was linked to provisions of the Criminal Code and clarified that the act must consist of an accusation about a matter intended to be made known to the public.

segments.src: 2. **Pasal 28 ayat (2) tentang ujaran kebencian** berdasarkan suku, agama, ras, dan antargolongan (SARA).
segments.tr: 2. **Article 28 paragraph (2) on hate speech** based on ethnicity, religion, race, and inter-group relations (SARA).

segments.src: 3. **Pasal 28 ayat (3) tentang informasi bohong** yang menimbulkan kerusuhan di masyarakat.
segments.tr: 3. **Article 28 paragraph (3) on false information** that causes unrest in society.

segments.src: 4. **Pasal 29 tentang ancaman kekerasan atau menakut-nakuti** yang ditujukan secara pribadi.
segments.tr: 4. **Article 29 on threats of violence or intimidation** directed at a person.

segments.src: Pada 2021, pemerintah menerbitkan Surat Keputusan Bersama (SKB) tentang pedoman implementasi pasal-pasal tertentu UU ITE.
segments.tr: In 2021, the government issued a Joint Decree (SKB) on guidelines for implementing certain articles of the ITE Law.

segments.src: Pedoman tersebut menegaskan, misalnya, bahwa kritik, penilaian, atau penyampaian fakta yang ditujukan untuk kepentingan umum tidak dapat dengan mudah dipidana sebagai pencemaran nama baik.
segments.tr: The guidelines affirm, for example, that criticism, assessment, or the presentation of facts made in the public interest cannot easily be prosecuted as defamation.

segments.src: Perubahan kedua UU ITE pada 2024 juga memuat penyesuaian rumusan agar lebih jelas.
segments.tr: The second amendment of the ITE Law in 2024 also adjusted some wording to make it clearer.

segments.src: Ketentuan pidana di dalamnya perlu dibaca bersama KUHP baru (UU No.
segments.tr: Its criminal provisions must be read together with the new Criminal Code (Law No.

segments.tr: 1 of 2023), which takes effect in 2026, so article references may change.

segments.src: Pastikan Anda memeriksa teks resmi terbaru di situs peraturan pemerintah sebelum mengambil langkah hukum.
segments.tr: Be sure to check the latest official text on government regulation websites before taking any legal action.

segments.src: ## Tips aman dan bijak berpendapat di media sosial
segments.tr: ## Tips for safe and responsible expression on social media

segments.src: - **Bedakan fakta dan opini.** Sampaikan kritik berdasarkan data atau pengalaman yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
segments.tr: - **Distinguish facts from opinions.** Base criticism on data or experiences that can be accounted for.

segments.src: - **Fokus pada isu, bukan menyerang pribadi.** Hindari kata-kata merendahkan, ancaman, atau tuduhan tanpa bukti.
segments.tr: - **Focus on the issue, not personal attacks.** Avoid demeaning language, threats, or accusations without evidence.

segments.src: - **Verifikasi sebelum membagikan.** Periksa sumber informasi agar tidak ikut menyebarkan kabar bohong.
segments.tr: - **Verify before sharing.** Check information sources so you do not help spread false news.

segments.src: - **Simpan bukti.** Tangkapan layar, tautan, tanggal, dan nama akun berguna jika Anda menjadi korban ancaman atau serangan digital.
segments.tr: - **Keep evidence.** Screenshots, links, dates, and account names are useful if you become a victim of threats or digital attacks.

segments.src: - **Jaga data pribadi.** Jangan menyebarkan alamat, nomor telepon, atau dokumen pribadi orang lain.
segments.tr: - **Protect personal data.** Do not spread other people's addresses, phone numbers, or personal documents.

segments.src: ## Jalur pengaduan dan perlindungan
segments.tr: ## Complaint channels and protection

segments.src: ### 1. Komnas HAM
segments.tr: ### 1. Komnas HAM

segments.src: Komisi Nasional Hak Asasi Manusia (Komnas HAM) menerima pengaduan dugaan pelanggaran HAM, termasuk pembatasan kebebasan berpendapat, intimidasi, atau perlakuan tidak adil oleh aparat maupun pihak lain.
segments.tr: The National Commission on Human Rights (Komnas HAM) receives complaints of alleged human rights violations, including restrictions on freedom of expression, intimidation, or unfair treatment by authorities or other parties.

segments.src: Langkah umumnya:
segments.tr: General steps:

segments.src: 1. Siapkan identitas pelapor dan kronologi kejadian secara runtut (siapa, apa, kapan, di mana).
segments.tr: 1. Prepare the complainant's identity and a clear, sequential account of the incident (who, what, when, where).

segments.src: 2. Lampirkan bukti pendukung, seperti dokumen, surat panggilan, tangkapan layar, atau rekaman.
segments.tr: 2. Attach supporting evidence, such as documents, summonses, screenshots, or recordings.

segments.src: 3. Ajukan pengaduan melalui kanal resmi Komnas HAM, baik datang langsung, surat, maupun layanan daring yang tersedia di situs resminya.
segments.tr: 3. Submit the complaint through Komnas HAM's official channels, whether in person, by letter, or through the online services available on its official website.

segments.src: 4. Catat nomor registrasi pengaduan dan pantau perkembangannya.
segments.tr: 4. Record the complaint registration number and monitor its progress.

segments.src: Komnas HAM dapat melakukan pemantauan, mediasi, atau mengeluarkan rekomendasi.
segments.tr: Komnas HAM may conduct monitoring and mediation, or issue recommendations.

segments.src: Perlu dipahami bahwa lembaga ini tidak menggantikan proses peradilan.
segments.tr: It should be understood that this institution does not replace judicial proceedings.

segments.src: ### 2. LPSK
segments.tr: ### 2. LPSK

segments.src: Lembaga Perlindungan Saksi dan Korban (LPSK) memberikan perlindungan bagi saksi, korban, dan pelapor dalam proses peradilan pidana.
segments.tr: The Witness and Victim Protection Agency (LPSK) protects witnesses, victims, and reporters in criminal proceedings.

segments.src: Bentuknya antara lain perlindungan fisik, pemenuhan hak prosedural, bantuan medis dan psikologis, serta restitusi atau kompensasi pada kasus tertentu.
segments.tr: Forms of protection include physical protection, fulfillment of procedural rights, medical and psychological assistance, and restitution or compensation in certain cases.

segments.src: Permohonan umumnya diajukan langsung oleh yang bersangkutan atau keluarganya, dengan menjelaskan ancaman yang dihadapi dan melampirkan bukti pendukung.
segments.tr: Applications are generally submitted directly by the person concerned or their family, explaining the threats they face and attaching supporting evidence.

segments.src: LPSK kemudian menilai apakah permohonan memenuhi syarat.
segments.tr: LPSK then assesses whether the application meets the requirements.

segments.src: ### 3. Jalur lain yang dapat ditempuh
segments.tr: ### 3. Other available avenues

segments.src: - **Bantuan hukum.** Lembaga Bantuan Hukum (LBH) dan organisasi bantuan hukum terakreditasi menyediakan pendampingan, sebagian gratis bagi yang memenuhi syarat.
segments.tr: - **Legal aid.** Legal aid institutions (LBH) and accredited legal aid organizations provide assistance, some of it free for those who qualify.

segments.src: - **Ombudsman RI** untuk dugaan maladministrasi dalam pelayanan publik.
segments.tr: - **Ombudsman RI** for alleged maladministration in public services.

segments.src: - **Kepolisian.** Ancaman, peretasan, atau doxing dapat dilaporkan melalui kanal resmi kepolisian, termasuk unit siber.
segments.tr: - **Police.** Threats, hacking, or doxing can be reported through official police channels, including cyber units.

segments.src: - **Laporan ke platform.** Fitur pelaporan di media sosial dapat dipakai untuk konten yang melanggar aturan komunitas.
segments.tr: - **Reports to platforms.** Social media reporting features can be used for content that violates community rules.

segments.src: - **Dewan Pers** bagi sengketa yang berkaitan dengan pemberitaan oleh media.
segments.tr: - **Dewan Pers (Press Council)** for disputes related to news reporting by the media.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Closing

segments.src: Hari HAM adalah pengingat bahwa kebebasan berekspresi dan tanggung jawab berjalan beriringan.
segments.tr: Human Rights Day is a reminder that freedom of expression and responsibility go hand in hand.

segments.src: Warga berhak menyampaikan kritik dan pendapat, dan negara berkewajiban melindungi hak tersebut sekaligus menegakkan batas yang sah.
segments.tr: Citizens have the right to voice criticism and opinions, and the state is obliged to protect that right while enforcing legitimate limits.

segments.src: Memahami aturan, menyimpan bukti, dan mengetahui ke mana harus melapor membantu warga berpartisipasi di ruang publik dengan lebih aman.
segments.tr: Understanding the rules, keeping evidence, and knowing where to report help citizens take part in public life more safely.

segments.src: Nomor pasal dan prosedur dapat berubah, sehingga periksa informasi terbaru di situs resmi lembaga terkait.*

id-20261126-pharmacology-1.title: [Pharmacology #1] What Happens After You Swallow a Pill?

segments.src: > Farmakologi adalah ilmu tentang obat: apa yang dilakukan obat pada tubuh (farmakodinamik), apa yang dilakukan tubuh pada obat (farmakokinetik), dan bagaimana obat baru sampai ke apotek.
segments.tr: > Pharmacology is the science of drugs: what the drug does to the body (pharmacodynamics), what the body does to the drug (pharmacokinetics), and how new drugs make it to the pharmacy.

segments.src: ## Konsep hari ini
segments.tr: ## Today's concept

segments.src: Pernah bertanya kenapa satu tablet kecil bisa meredakan demam?
segments.tr: Ever wonder why a single small tablet can relieve a fever?

segments.src: Atau kenapa ada obat yang harus diminum 3 kali sehari, sementara yang lain cukup sekali?
segments.tr: Or why some medicines must be taken 3 times a day, while others are enough just once?

segments.src: Pertanyaan-pertanyaan ini adalah inti **farmakologi**, yaitu ilmu yang mempelajari interaksi antara obat dan tubuh makhluk hidup.
segments.tr: These questions are at the heart of **pharmacology**, which is the study of the interactions between drugs and living bodies.

segments.src: Cara paling mudah memahaminya adalah membaginya menjadi dua arah:
segments.tr: The easiest way to understand it is to divide it into two directions:

segments.src: Farmakodinamik: apa yang dilakukan obat pada tubuh**
segments.tr: Pharmacodynamics: what the drug does to the body**

segments.src: Bagian ini membahas *bagaimana* obat bekerja.
segments.tr: This section discusses *how* drugs work.

segments.src: Kebanyakan obat bekerja dengan menempel pada "target" tertentu di tubuh, misalnya reseptor, enzim, atau saluran ion.
segments.tr: Most drugs work by attaching to specific "targets" in the body, such as receptors, enzymes, or ion channels.

segments.src: Bayangkan target itu sebagai gembok dan obat sebagai kunci.
segments.tr: Imagine the target as a lock and the drug as a key.

segments.src: Kalau kuncinya cocok, obat bisa mengaktifkan atau justru menghambat fungsi target tersebut.
segments.tr: If the key fits, the drug can activate or inhibit the function of that target.

segments.src: Farmakodinamik juga membahas hubungan dosis dan efek: dosis lebih besar biasanya memberi efek lebih kuat, tetapi hanya sampai batas tertentu, dan risiko efek samping ikut naik.
segments.tr: Pharmacodynamics also discusses the relationship between dose and effect: a larger dose usually gives a stronger effect, but only up to a certain point, and the risk of side effects increases along with it.

segments.src: Farmakokinetik: apa yang dilakukan tubuh pada obat**
segments.tr: Pharmacokinetics: what the body does to the drug**

segments.src: Begitu masuk, obat tidak diam saja.
segments.tr: Once inside, the drug does not just sit there.

segments.src: Tubuh "memprosesnya" melalui empat tahap yang sering disingkat **ADME**:
segments.tr: The body "processes" it through four stages often abbreviated as **ADME**:

segments.src: - **Absorpsi**: obat diserap, misalnya dari usus ke dalam darah.
segments.tr: - **Absorption**: the drug is absorbed, for example from the intestines into the blood.

segments.src: - **Distribusi**: obat beredar lewat darah ke berbagai jaringan.
segments.tr: - **Distribution**: the drug circulates via the blood to various tissues.

segments.src: - **Metabolisme**: obat diubah, terutama di hati, sering menjadi bentuk yang lebih mudah dibuang.
segments.tr: - **Metabolism**: the drug is altered, mainly in the liver, often into a form that is easier to excrete.

segments.src: - **Ekskresi**: obat atau sisanya dikeluarkan, terutama lewat ginjal (urine).
segments.tr: - **Excretion**: the drug or its remnants are eliminated, mainly via the kidneys (urine).

segments.src: Farmakokinetik inilah yang menentukan seberapa cepat obat mulai bekerja, berapa lama efeknya bertahan, dan seberapa sering obat perlu diminum.
segments.tr: It is this pharmacokinetics that determines how fast a drug starts working, how long its effects last, and how often the drug needs to be taken.

segments.src: **Dari laboratorium ke apotek**
segments.tr: **From laboratory to pharmacy**

segments.src: Obat baru tidak muncul begitu saja.
segments.tr: New drugs do not just appear out of nowhere.

segments.src: Prosesnya kira-kira seperti ini:
segments.tr: The process is roughly like this:

segments.src: 1. **Penemuan dan uji praklinik**: calon obat diuji di laboratorium, pada sel, dan pada hewan untuk melihat efek dan keamanannya.
segments.tr: 1. **Discovery and preclinical testing**: drug candidates are tested in the lab, on cells, and on animals to see their effects and safety.

segments.src: 2. **Uji klinik fase 1**: diuji pada sekelompok kecil orang (sering relawan sehat) untuk menilai keamanan dan dosis.
segments.tr: 2. **Phase 1 clinical trials**: tested on a small group of people (often healthy volunteers) to assess safety and dosage.

segments.src: 3. **Fase 2**: diuji pada pasien dalam jumlah lebih besar untuk melihat apakah obat benar-benar bermanfaat.
segments.tr: 3. **Phase 2**: tested on a larger number of patients to see if the drug is truly beneficial.

segments.src: 4. **Fase 3**: diuji pada ratusan hingga ribuan pasien, sering dibandingkan dengan obat standar atau plasebo.
segments.tr: 4. **Phase 3**: tested on hundreds to thousands of patients, often compared to a standard drug or placebo.

segments.src: 5. **Persetujuan izin edar**: di Indonesia, yang berwenang adalah **BPOM** (Badan Pengawas Obat dan Makanan).
segments.tr: 5. **Marketing authorization approval**: in Indonesia, the authority is **BPOM** (Drug and Food Control Agency).

segments.src: 6. **Fase 4 (pascapemasaran)**: setelah beredar, keamanan obat tetap dipantau pada populasi yang jauh lebih luas.
segments.tr: 6. **Phase 4 (post-marketing)**: once circulated, the safety of the drug continues to be monitored in a much wider population.

segments.src: Seluruh proses ini umumnya memakan waktu sekitar 10–15 tahun, dan sebagian besar calon obat gagal di tengah jalan.
segments.tr: This entire process generally takes about 10–15 years, and most drug candidates fail along the way.

segments.src: ## Dalam kehidupan sehari-hari
segments.tr: ## In daily life

segments.src: Misalkan anakmu demam setelah seharian bermain di luar, lalu kamu membeli paracetamol di apotek dekat rumah, yang versi generiknya biasanya hanya beberapa ribu rupiah per strip.
segments.tr: Suppose your child has a fever after playing outside all day, and then you buy paracetamol at the local pharmacy, where the generic version is usually only a few thousand rupiahs per strip.

segments.src: - **Sisi farmakodinamik**: paracetamol bekerja terutama di sistem saraf pusat, termasuk memengaruhi pusat pengatur suhu di otak, sehingga demam turun dan rasa nyeri berkurang. Mekanisme detailnya sampai sekarang masih diteliti.
segments.tr: - **Pharmacodynamic side**: paracetamol works primarily in the central nervous system, including affecting the temperature-regulation center in the brain, so fever goes down and pain is reduced. The detailed mechanism is still being studied to this day.

segments.src: - **Sisi farmakokinetik**: tablet diserap di usus, masuk ke darah, lalu diolah terutama oleh hati dan dibuang lewat ginjal. Karena tubuh terus membuangnya, efeknya hanya bertahan beberapa jam. Itulah sebabnya aturan pakai di kemasan menyebutkan jarak minum dan batas dosis harian.
segments.tr: - **Pharmacokinetic side**: the tablet is absorbed in the intestines, enters the blood, and is then processed mainly by the liver and eliminated through the kidneys. Because the body keeps eliminating it, the effect only lasts a few hours. That is why the usage instructions on the packaging mention the dosage interval and daily dose limit.

segments.src: Batas dosis itu penting: jika berlebihan, hasil metabolisme paracetamol dapat merusak hati.
segments.tr: That dose limit is important: if excessive, paracetamol metabolites can damage the liver.

segments.src: Jadi, aturan di kemasan bukan sekadar formalitas; aturan itu lahir dari pengetahuan farmakologi.
segments.tr: So, the rules on the packaging are not just a formality; those rules are born from pharmacological knowledge.

segments.src: Dan paracetamol di rak apotek itu bisa dijual karena sudah memiliki izin edar BPOM.
segments.tr: And the paracetamol on the pharmacy shelf can be sold because it already has a BPOM marketing authorization.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan dalam 3 baris
segments.tr: ## Summary in 3 lines

segments.src: 1. **Farmakodinamik** = efek obat pada tubuh (bagaimana dan di mana obat bekerja).
segments.tr: 1. **Pharmacodynamics** = the drug's effect on the body (how and where the drug works).

segments.src: 2. **Farmakokinetik** = perjalanan obat di dalam tubuh (ADME: absorpsi, distribusi, metabolisme, ekskresi).
segments.tr: 2. **Pharmacokinetics** = the drug's journey in the body (ADME: absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion).

segments.src: 3. Obat baru melewati uji praklinik, uji klinik fase 1–3, izin edar (di Indonesia oleh BPOM), lalu pemantauan fase 4.
segments.tr: 3. New drugs go through preclinical tests, phase 1–3 clinical trials, marketing authorization (in Indonesia by BPOM), then phase 4 monitoring.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-quiz

segments.src: **1.** "Obat X menghambat enzim tertentu sehingga peradangan berkurang."
segments.tr: **1.** "Drug X inhibits a certain enzyme so inflammation is reduced."

segments.src: Pernyataan ini termasuk kajian...
segments.tr: This statement belongs to the study of...

segments.src: - A. Farmakokinetik
segments.tr: - A. Pharmacokinetics

segments.src: - B. Farmakodinamik
segments.tr: - B. Pharmacodynamics

segments.src: - C. Uji praklinik
segments.tr: - C. Preclinical testing

segments.src: **2.** O/X: Tahap "M" dalam ADME adalah metabolisme, yang terutama terjadi di hati.
segments.tr: **2.** T/F: The "M" stage in ADME is metabolism, which mainly occurs in the liver.

segments.src: **3.** Tahap uji klinik yang biasanya melibatkan ratusan hingga ribuan pasien untuk memastikan efektivitas dan keamanan sebelum izin edar adalah...
segments.tr: **3.** The clinical trial stage that usually involves hundreds to thousands of patients to ensure effectiveness and safety before marketing authorization is...

segments.src: - A. Fase 1
segments.tr: - A. Phase 1

segments.src: - B. Fase 3
segments.tr: - B. Phase 3

segments.src: - C. Fase 4
segments.tr: - C. Phase 4

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah hari ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terms of the day

segments.src: - **Farmakologi**: ilmu yang mempelajari obat dan interaksinya dengan tubuh.
segments.tr: - **Pharmacology**: the science that studies drugs and their interactions with the body.

segments.src: - **Farmakodinamik**: kajian tentang efek obat pada tubuh dan mekanisme kerjanya.
segments.tr: - **Pharmacodynamics**: the study of the drug's effects on the body and its mechanism of action.

segments.src: - **Farmakokinetik**: kajian tentang perjalanan obat di dalam tubuh, dari masuk hingga dibuang.
segments.tr: - **Pharmacokinetics**: the study of the drug's journey in the body, from entry to elimination.

segments.src: - **ADME**: singkatan dari Absorpsi, Distribusi, Metabolisme, Ekskresi.
segments.tr: - **ADME**: stands for Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion.

segments.src: - **Uji klinik**: pengujian calon obat pada manusia secara bertahap (fase 1–4) untuk menilai keamanan dan manfaatnya.
segments.tr: - **Clinical trial**: testing drug candidates in humans in stages (phases 1–4) to assess their safety and benefits.

segments.tr: *Answer: 1-B (explains how the drug works on its target, so it belongs to pharmacodynamics).

segments.tr: 2-T (drug metabolism mainly takes place in the liver).
